bullets.text: Rajeshwari, a temporary worker at Ponneri Government Hospital, passed away after being set on fire, causing serious concern.
Four devotees were injured at the Tiruttani Murugan temple when portions of ancient deity statues collapsed.
Loganathan was arrested in Perungudi for strangling his wife to death following an argument over buying liquor.
Minister R. Kumar inspected the ongoing northeast monsoon preparedness works in the Adyar zone.
Chief Minister Vijay visited his Perambur MLA office and received petitions directly from the public.
TANGEDCO announced that power supply will be affected in nearly 190 locations in Chennai due to maintenance work.
CUMTA designated GST Road, Taramani Link Road, and part of Velachery-Tambaram Road as model urban mobility corridors.
Temporary workers of a private factory staged a hunger strike in Thiruvallur, leading to some employees fainting.
Avadi Corporation conducted a two-day disaster management training program for volunteers to assist during floods.
Railway union members held a protest demonstration at the Ponneri railway station pressing for various demands.
Senior IAS officer Priyanka Pankajam assumed charge as the CEO of the Tamil Nadu e-Governance Agency.
Anna University continues to see steady placement offers despite a global slowdown in IT and automobile sectors.
CoreWeave entered India through a partnership with the Adani Group to establish its first data centers.
Minister Rajmohan stated that TVK's Sathyabama was targeted with an AI-manipulated video in an act of ideological violence.
DMK leader M.K. Stalin criticized the state government over recent violent crime incidents across Tamil Nadu.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the Poonamallee to Porur metro rail service on October 11.
